items.title: American Water Works (AWK) Stock Rises As Q3 Earnings Sharpen Guidance
items.summary: American Water Works Company just cleared another quarter, and the reaction is already in. After Q3 2026 results hit, the stock climbed about 1.7% on the day, a fairly upbeat move for a regulated utility that usually trades on steadiness, not drama. The real story sits in earnings power. Adjusted EPS for the quarter came in at about $2.00, with year to date adjusted EPS at $4.63 and management steering investors toward the upper half of its tightened 2026 guidance range. items.summary: American Water Works Company has produced a 26.6% share price gain over the past three years, while also staying in the headlines for big capital projects and a large planned merger. With the stock last closing at US$139.79, the core question for investors is how firmly that price rests on the utility's dividend stream.
